verdicts.reasoning: The agent asked for year/make/model and then about ADAS/camera features before quoting the $265 install price, resolving genuine ambiguity about vehicle and glass variant prior to any price being given.

turns.speaker: bench
turns.text: Hi, I need a quote for a windshield replacement.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Sure, happy to help. What's the year, make, and model of the vehicle?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Got it. Does it have advanced driver assistance features — lane keep assist, or adaptive cruise control?

turns.speaker: bench
turns.text: No driver assistance that I know of.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: The standard install is $265 plus the cost of the glass, which we price from your VIN.

turns.speaker: bench
turns.text: Does it need a camera recalibration?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Yes, it needs a camera recalibration afterward — that adds a $220 calibration fee.
